# A package archive carries contentID/contentID, so two compiles whose
# inputs differ and whose output does not store one archive. The cache
# names an output by its content, so both list the same export file.
# An installed archive names its action, so a later build reads it as
# up to date.

[short] skip

env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $GOCACHE

# -gcflags=-e changes the action ID and not the object code.
go list -export -f '{{.BuildID}}' m/b
cp stdout plain-id.txt
go list -export -f '{{.Export}}' m/b
cp stdout plain-export.txt
go list -export -gcflags=-e -f '{{.BuildID}}' m/b
cp stdout flag-id.txt
go list -export -gcflags=-e -f '{{.Export}}' m/b
cp stdout flag-export.txt
! cmp plain-id.txt flag-id.txt
cmp plain-export.txt flag-export.txt

# The install writes the full build ID into its copy.
go build -o $WORK/b.a m/b
go tool buildid $WORK/b.a
cp stdout stamp.txt
cmp plain-id.txt stamp.txt

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.23
-- b/b.go --
package b

func B() int { return 1 }
